name: neus-mcp
description: Connect your assistant to verified identity, scoped permissions, and reusable trust receipts.

interface.shortDescription: Verify identity and permissions before agents act.
interface.longDescription: Connect your assistant to verified identity, scoped permissions, and reusable trust receipts. In Cursor, installing this plugin registers NEUS and signs you in. For Codex, VS Code, and Claude Code, use the public CLI.
defaultPrompt: Use NEUS to check identity and permissions before taking action.
Use NEUS to check trust receipts for this wallet or organization.
